pages.text: A charm is a creature's material, infused. Each works from $(l)anywhere in your inventory$().$(br2)All are infusions at the $(l)Ritual Altar$() (or in an Infuser), with lit candles 2 out on each side and the blocks below 2 out on each diagonal. Each needs Ascension.

pages.title: Wispbound Charm
pages.text: Your mana regenerates faster.$(br2)$(l)Offer:$() Wisp Essence$(br)$(l)Diagonals:$() Amethyst Blocks$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 120

pages.title: Mothwing Charm
pages.text: You drift down instead of falling. Hold Sneak to drop.$(br2)$(l)Offer:$() Moth Wing Dust$(br)$(l)Diagonals:$() Glowstone$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 120

pages.title: Huntsman's Charm
pages.text: Hostile creatures near you glow, and magic strikes glowing foes harder.$(br2)$(l)Offer:$() Antler Shard$(br)$(l)Diagonals:$() Amethyst Blocks$(br)$(l)Also:$() Glimmerstone Ore 3 out on each side$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 140

pages.title: Shadeweave Charm
pages.text: Below 30% health you vanish for five seconds and enemies lose you. Once a minute.$(br2)$(l)Offer:$() Shade Cloth$(br)$(l)Diagonals:$() Crying Obsidian$(br)$(l)Also:$() Voidstone Ore 3 out on each side$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 160

pages.title: Tidebound Charm
pages.text: Breathe and swim freely underwater.$(br2)$(l)Offer:$() Lurker Scale$(br)$(l)Diagonals:$() Prismarine$(br)$(l)Mana:$() 120

pages.title: Mana Tonic
pages.text: Drink to restore 120 mana. The bottle is returned.
